An Application Under Section 482 Of The vs In Re.: Debabrata
Bag on 29 December, 2025
 55.
29.12.2025.
 ap
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
 C.R.R. 5124 of 2025
In the matter of: an application under Section 482 of the  Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section  528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed on  26.11.2025.

Mr. Phiroze Edulji, ld. Sr. Advocate,
 Ms. Soumili Choudhury,
 Mr. Aritra Ranjan Dutta Roy.

1. 
The present revisional application is filed praying for quashing of the proceedings being G.R. Case No. 1355 of 2023 under Sections 341/323/420/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 including order dated 09.04.2025 passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Haldia whereby purported cognizance of Charge-sheet No. 81 of 2025 dated 22.03.2025 has been taken and is now pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Haldia, Purba Medinipur.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Haldia
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Haldia, Purba Medinipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. It appears prima facie that there was initially a business transaction between the parties and subsequently the present case has been registered.
3. The instant revisional application is required to be heard.

4. The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the instant revisional application upon the opposite party no.1 through the Office of the Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon the opposite party no.2 by Registered Speed Post with Acknowledgment Due Card and file affidavit-of-service on the next date fixed for hearing.

entities.text: Office of the Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
5. List the instant revisional application before the Regular Bench in the Monthly Combined List of February, 2026 subject to convenience of that Bench under the heading "Contested Application".
